dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extent - Beledweyne City, Beledweyne District, Hiraan Region of Somalia as of 19 May 2023
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code FL20230327SOM, GDACS Id: 1101908** This map illustrates satellite-detected surface waters over Beledweyne City, Beledweyne District, Hiraan Region of Somalia as observed from a Sentinel-2 image acquired on 19 May 2023 at 07:28 UTC. Within the analysed area of 166 km², about 63 km² of land appear to be flooded. Water extent appears to have increased by about 9 km² since 14 May 2023. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
